set.body: First bounded P2.3 slice in port/docs/roadmap.md. Reuse current document identity/coreference semantics and ADRs; connect repeated mentions across recall/source units within each account without conflating cross-account identity. Acceptance: recurring actor in different events, ambiguous identity retained, attributed contexts preserved, changed unrelated recall cannot mutate source identities; saved deterministic receipt and independent readback. Cross-modal identity and full speech promotion remain owed P2/P5 work.
set.title: P2.3 Resolve cross-unit mention identity with explicit alternatives
